children: The results season momentum picks up pace again after the Dusshera holiday on Tuesday as a slew of companies that reported results after market hours on Monday, will be reacting to their results today. Bajaj Finance will be the most prominent among them, with their FY27 AUM guidance increase but warning on margins. IREDA, Hindustan Zinc, NELCO, Piramal Finance, SML Mahindra, Sobha, Just Dial, L&T Technology Services, Tatva Chintan Pharma are some of the other important result reactions today. Eternal will be the biggest Nifty 50 name reporting numbers today. Vishal Mega Mart, SRF, Indian Hotels, KEI Industries, M&M Finance, PC Jewellers, Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC, International Gemmological Institute, Wendt, Mahindra Holidays are some of the other companies that will be reporting their results today.
Check this space for LIVE Updates on Q2 Results, analysis, stock reactions, brokerage views, management commentary and more.

title: Q2 Results LIVE Updates: Bajaj Finance, Just Dial react to earnings; Eternal, SRF report today
